title: How Australian small businesses are using AI to save time and improve productivity
headline: NAB and National AI Centre partner on practical SME AI training
summary: National Australia Bank and the National AI Centre are collaborating on a practical AI training program to help Australian small and medium enterprises adopt artificial intelligence safely and confidently. The announcement highlights real-world adoption examples across accounting, healthcare, and physiotherapy, where businesses are using custom agents and workflow automation. NAB research indicates that 40% of SMEs are already using AI while seeking guidance on secure and responsible usage.
why_it_matters: Australian organisations supporting small business digital adoption must provide practical, security-focused guidance and training to help SMEs navigate AI risks safely.

quotes.text: NAB is partnering with the National AI Centre to develop training that helps businesses adopt AI safely and confidently.
The practical education program is designed to help businesses identify opportunities for AI, build capability and apply technology in ways that improve productivity and support growth.

dates_mentioned.what: Publication of NAB research finding 40% SME AI adoption

classification.significance_reason: An industry initiative by a major Australian bank and the National AI Centre to support safe SME AI adoption, but lacking binding regulatory or compliance obligations.
